description: Salons, spas, barbers, clinics and other businesses on WAJ that take bookings through AI assistants, by name, service, category or area, nearest first when a location is given. Each result has a `business` value that identifies the business.

latitude.description: Latitude of where the customer wants to go (their location or the centre of the area they named). Give with longitude to sort nearest first.
latitude.title: Latitude

query.description: Words to match: the business's name, a service (e.g. 'gel nails', 'beard trim'), a category or an area or street. Every word has to match. Omit to list by distance only.
query.title: Query

radius_km.description: Only businesses with a branch within this many km of latitude/longitude.
radius_km.title: Radius Km

name: search_businesses
title: Find a business
